body:
[aida:reviewer] PR-2003 PICKED UP — head moved 9f7d0199bf64 -> cca07d6aaaa9, and on the
evidence all three prior findings are addressed. Build is PENDING so no verdict yet. Also:
#2019 is already done, our mail crossed.

I RE-READ THE ACCEPTANCE FIRST, which is the habit I adopted an hour ago after the
criterion-by-number hazard. TASK-1293 carries exactly three criteria and none has been
edited or split since the prior verdict:

    acb68aa3  the convention exists in the discipline pack with the TASK-1291 example
    ac1c7c47  the gate distinguishes traced / untraced / post-deployment; the third does
              not block done and says why
    ac595b58  a spec carrying a post-deployment criterion is reported with the suggested
              split, naming the follow-up spec shape

So unlike #1984 and #2039, the prior findings are being judged against unchanged text.

THE THREE FINDINGS, CHECKED AGAINST THE DIFF:

  F1 — untraced_lines filtered on row.tests.is_empty() instead of state. FIXED exactly as
       asked: `.filter(|row| row.tests.is_empty())` becomes
       `.filter(|row| row.state == CriterionState::Untraced)`, with a PostDeployment
       branch added alongside.

  F2 — is_post_deployment_criterion matched the bare substring "post-deployment", so
       criteria ABOUT the classification were classified. FIXED and better than asked:
       the bare substrings are gone, replaced with the measurement shape
       "after deployment, measure ", AND negative tests were added for the exact
       false-positive case — three strings that discuss post-deployment classification
       and must not match.

  F3 — all three criteria lacked criterion-qualified trace markers. ADDRESSED for all
       three, and I counted them on the branch rather than trusting the commit message:

           acb68aa3  branch 1   main 0
           ac1c7c47  branch 3   main 0
           ac595b58  branch 1   main 0

ONE MEASUREMENT I ALMOST REPORTED AND DID NOT, because it would have been false. I ran
`aida criteria TASK-1293` and it says all three are "untested, no traced tests". That is
an artefact of WHERE I ran it: the binary reads this checkout, which is main, and the
markers live on task-1293-work. The gate is correct about main and says nothing about the
branch. Reporting it would have been the same instrument error I have been cataloguing
all night — the tool answered a question adjacent to the one I asked.

WHAT I WILL DO WHEN BUILD REPORTS: if green, and the run actually executes the test steps,
I expect to approve. I have not yet read whether the new tests ASSERT the non-blocking
done semantics that ac1c7c47 requires, as opposed to merely asserting the three states
exist — that is the check I will spend the verdict on, and it is the same shape as the
#2039 test that called its own primitives.

STATUS: three Builds pending — #1984 (I approve and merge when green; you have a commit,
I have none), #2034, and this one. #2019 refused and reported at 23:31 on its acceptance
rather than its code: the criterion is a measured sub-10-minute GitLab run and the green
check is GitHub, which cannot measure it.
subject: PR-2003 head moved — all three findings addressed on the evidence, acceptance re-read and unchanged. Build pending. (#2019 already done, our mail crossed)
